inputs: movement competence and task-specific load history
logic: Eligibility and scope first; ask if genuinely unknown
Use self-report as self-report, not verified observation
Choose productive low-demand entry in demonstrated patterns; no perfect product history requirement
Compose full requested scope only if every task and window is supported
Unknown externally loaded task does not acquire load from generic priors
startingPriors: Registry operational bounds; individualized efficacy unknown
limits: No complete-program efficacy from one familiarization
Unknown movement/load or impossible windows can still require ASK
